responsibility: Implements Xtensa ABI classification by tracking available argument and return GPRs, deciding when values must spill to the stack, coercing register-passed aggregates into 32-bit or 64-bit integer sequences, widening sub-32-bit scalars, and rewriting oversized returns to backend-managed indirect form.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `spec/base/xtensa.rs`, this Xtensa file is the call ABI implementation: it tracks available argument/return GPRs, decides stack spilling, coerces register-passed aggregates, and rewrites oversized returns, rather than defining general target options.
